The '''Dauntless Run''' was a small [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] in the [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor]] and [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] that ran between [[Ota]] and [[Pizilis]]. [[Rorgam]] was a stop along the route.
